about_the_game:
Crazyness: Weird Village

A first-person game in which you will take on the role of Jacob.

Jacob is a sport shooter and shooting instructor at a club in the city of São Manuel.
Accustomed to participating in target shooting events and championships, he leads a peaceful life… until, after marrying Mily, the couple decides to move to a quieter and more isolated place.

What they didn’t imagine is that this move could cost them their lives.
Soon, Jacob and Mily will discover that their new home may not be as peaceful as it seemed.
